column1: # Divider icon assignments. One row per section-divider slide, in deck order.
# `n` is the 1-based divider index within the deck, counting only section
# dividers -- the deck title slide is not one. Keying on the index rather than
# on the heading text keeps this stable when a section gets reworded, and the
# wiring script checks the recorded title against the file so a drift is an
# error rather than a silently misplaced icon.
# source=catalog  the file is already in icons/ and unused elsewhere
# source=pilot    already wired on the C/07/a pilot, kept as-is
# source=new      needs exporting from Lordicon. Set secondary to #2a76dd in the
#                 customizer BEFORE exporting or the icon bakes in Lordicon's
#                 green -- see ICONS.md. `search` is the term to start from;
#                 `icon` is the filename to save it as.
# Reserved and deliberately not reused: map.json (the roadmap slide's recurring
# motif) and the 25 other icons already carrying meaning on a content slide.
